program='''def transform(grid):
    """Paint every all-zero copy of the rare marker-color shape."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    # The shape is the sparse non-background color; zero is the matching canvas.
    marker = min((v for v in counts if v != 0), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in pts); r1 = max(r for r, c in pts)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in pts); c1 = max(c for r, c in pts)
    shape = {(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in pts}
    sh, sw = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc] = marker
    return out
'''
